lesson.summary: The first scheduled run of review-notes.yml after #625 did what #625 claimed: its new `metrics` job ran `metrics.sh` and wrote metrics.md on the sessions branch, so nothing needs changing.
lesson.detail: #625 added a second job, `metrics`, to review-notes.yml. The job has `contents: write` and runs `factory/scripts/metrics.sh` to write the weekly delivery numbers to `metrics.md` on the `sessions` branch (H613g). In run 46035662846 both jobs succeeded. `start` took 16 seconds. In `metrics`, the step that ran `metrics.sh` took about 9 seconds and logged `wrote https://github.com/edmulraney/tinyfactory/blob/sessions/metrics.md`, and the page holds week 2026-W47. The Neon usage step was skipped because `NEON_PROJECT_ID` is not set, which is what its `if:` asks for. The facts show the changed step with no job, conclusion or log only because a later change renamed it to "Write the page of the factory's delivery numbers and the product's usage by week". The name from #625's diff therefore matched no step in this run. The step itself ran.

cost.amount: Nothing: the run succeeded in about 17 seconds and started no agent session ($0, 0 turns).

lesson.saves: Nothing: the run lost no work, money or time.
